title: LE Decorative Lighting Alternatives 2026: Best Picks
body_markdown:
LE (Lighting EVER) built its business on affordable string lights and plug-in decorative sets you install for one holiday and take down before the next storm. That's a real strength: low upfront cost, wide color selection, and a setup any homeowner can do with a ladder and an extension cord. The ceiling shows up in year two — faded bulbs, brittle wiring after a winter on the roofline, and the same climb up and down the ladder every November and January. **The best LE decorative lighting alternative in 2026 is CleanGutters Lighting's permanent roofline LED system if you want lighting that stays installed and changes color on command; Trimlight or Gemstone Lights if you're outside South Jersey, Eastern Pennsylvania, or Northern Delaware and need a dealer closer to home.**


**TL;DR**

- CleanGutters Lighting wins for permanent, app-controlled roofline lighting across South Jersey, Eastern PA, and Northern Delaware in 2026.
- LE (Lighting EVER) still makes sense for one-season budget decorating, not year-round architectural lighting.
- Trimlight and Gemstone Lights are the closest national alternatives if you live outside CleanGutters Lighting's service area.
- Permanent systems install once and run 365 days a year; LE strings get taken down and re-hung every season.


## Why this matters

Seasonal string lights were never built to survive on a roofline year-round. UV exposure cracks the plastic housing, freeze-thaw cycles pull staples and clips loose, and every string swap means another ladder trip. Homeowners searching for **LE decorative lighting alternatives** are usually past the point of wanting to redo the same install every year — they want something that goes up once and gets controlled from a phone.

The [permanent outdoor lighting systems compared](https://cleangutterslighting.com/blog/best-permanent-outdoor-lighting-systems-compared) breakdown covers how these systems differ from seasonal strings on channel design and mounting, but the short version: permanent systems recess LEDs into an aluminum channel fixed to the fascia, so nothing hangs, sags, or needs to be re-clipped each season.

## Alternatives to LE decorative lighting, at a glance

| System | Best for | Standout feature | How it differs from LE |
|---|---|---|---|
| LE (Lighting EVER) | Budget, single-season decorating | Wide color/string variety, low cost of entry | Seasonal only, hand-installed each time |
| CleanGutters Lighting | Permanent roofline lighting in NJ/PA/DE | Owner-installed architectural LED channel | Installed once, app-controlled year-round |
| Trimlight | Permanent lighting via national dealer network | Franchise install outside CleanGutters Lighting's region | Permanent channel system, dealer quality varies by franchise |
| Gemstone Lights | Permanent lighting, national dealer network | RGB pixel control, dealer-installed | Permanent channel system, similar dealer-quality variance |

### 1. CleanGutters Lighting: best for permanent roofline lighting in South Jersey, Eastern PA, and Northern Delaware

CleanGutters Lighting installs a fixed LED channel along the roofline that runs year-round instead of coming down after New Year's. Alex installs every job personally rather than handing it to subcontractors, which matters on a lighting install where clip spacing and channel alignment show on the house every night, not just during a holiday.

**Where CleanGutters Lighting shines:**
- Installed once, controlled by app for all 365 days of the year — no re-hanging strings for the next holiday
- Owner-installed, not subcontracted, on every job
- Paired naturally with gutter guard and gutter repair work already done on the same roofline

**Where CleanGutters Lighting falls short:**
- Only serves South Jersey, Eastern Pennsylvania, and Northern Delaware — not a fit if you live outside that footprint
- A full install is a bigger upfront project than clipping up a string of LE lights for one weekend

**Best for:** homeowners in the tri-state service area who want architectural lighting they never take down.

| Dimension | CleanGutters Lighting | LE (Lighting EVER) |
|---|---|---|
| Install type | Permanent aluminum channel | Seasonal string, hand-hung |
| Season | Year-round, 365 days | Holiday season only |
| Control | App-controlled color changes | Manual plug/timer or basic app on select sets |
| Weather exposure | Built for permanent exterior mounting | Designed for temporary seasonal exposure |

### 2. Trimlight: best for permanent lighting outside the tri-state area

Trimlight runs on a franchise dealer model, so the install channel and app platform are consistent, but installation quality depends on which local dealer handles the job. It's a reasonable alternative to LE decorative lighting for homeowners who want a permanent system but live outside CleanGutters Lighting's service area.

**Where Trimlight shines:**
- National dealer footprint, so coverage exists in most regions
- Permanent channel system with app-based color control

**Where Trimlight falls short:**
- Install quality varies by which local franchisee handles the job
- No CleanGutters Lighting owner-installed guarantee since it's a different brand and network

**Best for:** homeowners who want permanent lighting but live outside South Jersey, Eastern PA, or Northern Delaware. The full [Trimlight alternatives](https://cleangutterslighting.com/blog/best-trimlight-alternatives) comparison breaks down how dealer-installed systems stack up against each other in more detail.

### 3. Gemstone Lights: best for RGB pixel control via dealer install

Gemstone Lights is another dealer-installed permanent system, positioned around fine-grained RGB pixel control rather than fixed-color channels. Like Trimlight, it's delivered through independent dealers rather than one company installing every job.

**Where Gemstone Lights shines:**
- Pixel-level color control for detailed lighting effects
- Permanent install, no seasonal take-down

**Where Gemstone Lights falls short:**
- Dealer network means install consistency depends on the local franchise
- Not available as a CleanGutters Lighting-installed option in the tri-state region

**Best for:** homeowners wanting granular pixel-color effects who are shopping outside CleanGutters Lighting's coverage area. The [Gemstone lighting alternatives](https://cleangutterslighting.com/blog/best-gemstone-lighting-alternatives) page covers how it compares to other dealer-based permanent brands.

### 4. LE (Lighting EVER): best for one-season budget decorating

LE remains a fair pick if you only need lights up for a few weeks a year and don't want a permanent install commitment. It's a plug-in string, not an architectural system, and that's the honest way to frame it against permanent alternatives.

**Where LE shines:**
- Low cost of entry for seasonal decorating
- Wide selection of colors and string lengths, easy to buy off the shelf

**Where LE falls short:**
- Strings degrade faster outdoors year-round than a permanent channel system
- Requires re-installation and take-down every season, ladder work included
- No architectural integration with the roofline — it sits on top rather than being built into it

**Best for:** renters or homeowners who only decorate for one holiday and don't want a permanent fixture.

## Why people switch from LE

- **Annual re-installation gets old.** Climbing the ladder every November and again every January to take strings down is the single most common reason homeowners look at permanent alternatives.
- **String lights aren't built for year-round exposure.** A system rated for seasonal use degrades faster when left up through a full New Jersey or Eastern Pennsylvania winter and summer.
- **App control on permanent systems covers more than one holiday.** A fixed channel system can run color patterns for any season without swapping physical strings, something covered in more depth on the [permanent lighting ranked by app control features](https://cleangutterslighting.com/blog/permanent-lighting-systems-ranked-by-app-control-features) page.
- **Cost adds up over years of replacement strings.** The [permanent Christmas lights cost](https://cleangutterslighting.com/blog/how-much-do-permanent-christmas-lights-cost-in) breakdown lays out how a one-time permanent install compares to buying new seasonal strings every year or two.

## When staying with LE is the right call

If you're renting, decorating for a single event, or you genuinely enjoy the yearly ritual of putting lights up and taking them down, LE decorative lighting still does the job it was built for. Permanent lighting is a bigger commitment and it's meant for homeowners who want the roofline lit every day of 2026, not just during one holiday stretch.

## FAQ


**What's the best LE decorative lighting alternative for year-round use?**

CleanGutters Lighting's permanent roofline system is the best year-round alternative to LE decorative lighting in South Jersey, Eastern PA, and Northern Delaware. It installs once and runs through all 365 days rather than coming down after the holidays.

**Is permanent lighting better than LE string lights?**

Permanent lighting is better for homeowners who want lighting up year-round without annual re-installation. LE string lights are still a reasonable, lower-cost choice for single-season decorating.

**Does CleanGutters Lighting install permanent lighting outside New Jersey?**

No. CleanGutters Lighting installs permanent roofline lighting only in South Jersey, Eastern Pennsylvania, and Northern Delaware. Homeowners outside that footprint should look at dealer networks like Trimlight or Gemstone Lights.

**Can I control permanent roofline lighting from my phone?**

Yes. Permanent systems like CleanGutters Lighting's are app-controlled, letting you change colors and patterns without touching the physical fixtures.

**How is permanent lighting different from LE decorative lights on installation?**

Permanent lighting is installed once into a fixed aluminum channel on the fascia. LE decorative lights are hand-hung strings that go up and come down each season.

**Do Trimlight and Gemstone Lights install their own systems?**

No. Both brands operate through independent local dealers, so installation quality can vary by franchise rather than being handled by one company on every job.

**Is LE decorative lighting durable enough to leave up year-round?**

LE strings are built for seasonal use, not permanent year-round exposure, and tend to degrade faster than a purpose-built permanent channel system left up through every season.


## One last thing

The strongest case against LE decorative lighting isn't the light quality — it's the ladder trips. Two seasonal installs a year, every year, is the real cost that a permanent system removes entirely starting the day it's installed in 2026.
